thread:
Lena: FYI eu-west1c started filling Pending tiny-gpu pods around 13:18 UTC. Lots of attach timeouts + immediate preemptions.
Marco: Any new rollouts? affinity/taint changes?
Lena: We rolled gpu-load-taint enforcement yesterday and a tighter anti-affinity rule this morning. Scheduler events show 'bind rejected: attach deadline exceeded' and then a preempt to try to free contiguous capacity.
Ibrahim: Node metrics: kube-proxy conntrack high on rack-7, and attach-service logs show `read tcp ...: ECONNRESET`. Looks like packet drops causing attach RPCs to fail mid-handshake.
Zoe: That will amplify fragmentation: small pods can't attach fast enough so scheduler keeps reshuffling. Cost team flagged a bump in on-demand fallbacks for tiny workloads.
Marco: Quick mitigations: (A) increase tiny warmpool in eu-west1c; (B) route attach RPCs to healthy AZ when latency > 6s; (C) enable a region-scoped soft-affinity fallback for tiny pods; (D) temporarily relax the gpu-load-taint for pods with label `tier=infra-test`. Which order?
Lena: Prefer A + B + C minimal blast radius. Relaxing taint globally is risky.
infra-bot: running preflight: warmpool quota ok for +10, no active scheduler config rollout, attach-service healthy in eu-west1b.
Ibrahim: I'll open a networking ticket to investigate conntrack tail and possible kube-proxy restart window for rack-7. Meanwhile add envoy route to forward ~30% of attach calls from eu-west1c to eu-west1b as fallback when latency spikes.
Marco: I'll push a canary scheduler patch: 20% softAffinityFallback for pods with `gpu.class=tiny` in eu-west1c only. Patch payload small and reversible.
Lena: Executing: `warmpoolctl scale --region eu-west1c --pool tiny-gpu --add 10` and apply canary config. Will monitor admit latency, preempt/sec, pending count, and egress delta.
Zoe: Add alert: if preempt/sec > 40 for >5m or pending tiny-gpu > 220 raise page to oncall. Also track cross-AZ egress to watch for cost regressions.
Lena: Warmpool scaled +10, canary applied. Early: pending down ~28% on canary nodes, preempt/sec trending down. Envoy fallback is routing ~18% of attach traffic to eu-west1b.
Ibrahim: Network ticket INFNET-427 created for rack-7 conntrack surge and kube-proxy logs. If we still see ECONNRESET after fallback, we may need to cordon/replace affected nodes.
Marco: If canary stable for 30m, ramp to 100% for region and defer full taint enforcement for tiny workloads until packer+sim finishes. Rollback: remove canary + scale warmpool down.
Lena: Will update in 15m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
